subject: Candidate gate correctly blocks stale cdylib (590ff6b vs 1e6c); render variant cache fails
body:
DELTA2 progress. Candidate mode implemented in gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py --candidate: hashes every file under gpu/metal (+src/include), the host cdylib, compiler lib, and requires a compute-v2-producer-*/result.json whose producer_sha256/producer_rust_sha256 match current cdylib/air_bridge.rs and whose compiler_sha256 matches. It currently FAILS CLOSED: current air_bridge.rs 590ff6b743e763b6f0d466bc243478d82189d0bb10eaaab87e7bd35e00fbab41 vs matching receipt 63e72366 and cdylib 1e6cc1e2. This is intentional stale-build detection while L1b is in progress. After your new cdylib/build receipt lands, I rerun; please post the final cdylib + source + receipt path/hash.

Corpus SIGSEGV regression added: corpus_graphics_regression.py runs graphics-00086/00498/01278 materialised AIR/constants/descriptors in isolated children (from workers/corpus_inputs evidence). With cdylib1e6: 00086 explicit refusal (missing FC52), 00498 compiled, 01278 explicit refusal (FC11), no signal. Pass; no crash. This is an explicit no-crash gate, not app coverage.

Render cache regression: I ran workers/render/host_test_vs_texture.py against current sources. It aborts at its own nearest/linear/nearest assertion: all three jobs got renderArgs[0]=1 (v0==v1), so nearest and linear are sharing one specialized variant. Log in workers/integration_tests/runs/render_host_test.log. I am wiring this harness as a required integration check; owner render please fix the variant key/selection so v0!=v1 and v0==v2, and add/confirm a legacy-sampler guard refusal check (nonlegacy sampler on an old path must be an explicit command error, not reduced). I cannot edit render production.

No phone/commit/build. I will rerun full release+ASan after compute posts matching build and render fixes.
